messages:
marta: customer reported tool call failing intermittently when uploading small binary blob (ocr image). error: "schema_validation: expected base64 string for 'file.bytes' but got object"

alice: ouch. do we have repro? which SDKs are hitting it?

marta: reproduction across TS + Go clients. Python client seems fine. minimal repro attached below (TS):
```ts
const buf = new Uint8Array(await fetch('/img.jpg').then(r=>r.arrayBuffer()));
await client.callTool('ocr', { file: { filename: 'img.jpg', bytes: buf } });
```
server log: `ValidationError: file.bytes: must be base64 string`

dev_ricardo: sounds like the TS SDK is leaving a raw TypedArray in the JSON which the gateway treats as object -> schema fail. but why python ok? python serializes bytes -> base64 by default.

ben: can you capture the raw payload the SDK sends (before network)? maybe a hidden stringify bug where we wrap then JSON.stringify again? also any difference if you pass `bytes: buf.buffer` vs `bytes: Array.from(buf)`?

marta: tried both. `Array.from(buf)` becomes array of ints (bad). `buf.buffer` becomes ArrayBuffer object. both rejected. for customer they send Blob in browser. they only see failure from web client (ts) and server rejects with 400. go client sends `[]byte` and gateway accepts in our staging sometimes but fails when nested under optional `metadata` key.

ingrid: this looks like a marshalling edge when the bytes field is nested inside a union/optional tag. serializer tries to detect binary, but our detection matches on Buffer/Uint8Array only at top-level. nested typed arrays fall through and end up being encoded by structuredClone -> produces object.

marta: attaching captured payloads:
```json
{"file":{"filename":"img.jpg","bytes":{}}}
```
(weird empty object seen for typedarray)

ben: thanks. I think we have a regression from the v2 TS serializer change. patch idea: run a deep check for ArrayBuffer/TypedArray and convert to base64 string before generic stringify. quickfix on SDK side should land today.

support_bot: ticket #INC-2026 created, priority P2, assigned to sdk-js team. billing note: customer hit 1000 failed calls — no charge until resolved.

dev_ricardo: also want to add a robust unit test: tool calls with nested optional bytes under structs/unions for py/ts/go. we probably missed nested path.

alice: customer asked for a quick workaround — suggested they pre-encode to base64 string manually in TS as `bytes: btoa(String.fromCharCode(...buf))` and confirmed that works. shared snippet to customer and asked them to test.

marta: customer confirmed manual base64 works. they can test staging patch later.

ingrid: I'll open PR to adjust serializer deep-detection + add e2e. cc @ben for review.

ben: will cut a patch release (sdk-js v1.4.3) after review. will also add telemetry to log occurrences of object-in-bytes so we can detect regressions.

marta: great. I'll keep ticket updated and request replay logs from customer once they test. :thumbsup:

alice: moving to monitor, please ping here when patch is published so I can tell customer.

marta: will do — thanks all.
